asset_ownership_interpretation: Neutrl's reviewed public materials establish that NUSD and sNUSD are exposed to protocol reserve and strategy-position liquidity, but the reviewed August 2026 incident sources do not establish a simple customer-owned versus platform-owned legal characterization for all holder claims.
notes: The key bounded risk is reserve/strategy liquidity impairment with redemption suspended and recovery value unresolved. Earlier reserve-dashboard totals are dated snapshots and must not be converted into an inferred loss by subtracting the later USD 27 million liquid-asset figure.
